findings.summary: Drop the stale comment and [[maybe_unused]] on the frame delta in both PALs: the frame trace, sprite passes and billboard passes read it.
Pin the JSON runtime header's includers in the existing 'included only by the scenes that reach it' test instead of a new file: the glTF loader is its only owner.
State in the fidelity Frame time row that the sprite-layer and billboard effect clocks carry the double delta.

Re-measure platformer's canvas-only lane rather than carry the old note: both lanes moved (0.013/0.010 to 0.004/0.000), consistent with the CRT layer's effect clock feeding a grain hash; the status note and registry comment carry the measured values.
Carry the JSON runtime in the precompiled header only behind the same gate as its include path, so a unit that includes it without reaching JSON fails in development as in the static tree.
Route the animation-manager delta through the float sink rule.
findings.blockedBy: Not a defect: compileNumber renders the argument at float width already; generated scene152 passes static_cast<float>(v_bblite_frame_delta_5).
findings.filedIn: cleared by measurement in this record

findings.summary: Run one sprite scene and one audio scene through MSVC before shipping, and consider clang-cl's -Wimplicit-float-conversion and -Wshorten-64-to-32 so the development loop reports MSVC's narrowing class.
findings.blockedBy: The count of existing narrowing sites under those clang warnings is unmeasured and needs a -Wno-error build first; an MSVC build of a registry scene currently replaces its development tree.
